title.narrative: Providing life-saving Multisectoral Emergency Response for vulnerable pop'n affected by multiple emergencies in Kena Woreda of Konso Zone of SNNPR, Ethiopia

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThe humanitarian condition of the most vulnerable household remains high lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtdue to the spillover lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtimpact of long-standing drought.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtit is anticipated the recovery or moderate improvement from the 2022-2023 drought lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtwill take multiple favorable seasons requires and humanitarian assistance will be critical to ensure household basic need and rebuild their lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtlivelihood and coping capacity. The agricultural and livestock losses will lead to a significantly sharp rise in food insecurity and malnutrition. The drought emergency compounded by other crisis and disproportionally affecting women and Girls Humanitarian assistance remains critical for saving lives and preventing the extreme level of acute food insecurity. MCMDO proposed to implement live saving integrated multisectoral emergency response oflt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtWASH, Agriculture, MPC and protection services in an integrated manner for vulnerable population affected by multiple emergencies in Kena woreda of Konso zone of SNNPR Where MCMDO have an active physical presence.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThe proposed interventions are in line with 1st reserve allocation and the cluster key priorities.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThe MPC parts of the projects which gives flexibility and empower the affected population to prioritize their critical need in multiple emergencies, and complementing WASH, protection and agriculture intervention. The over objective of WASH component is to enable Vulnerable IDPlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtand Host communities willlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gthave access tolt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtsafelt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtwater supply through rehabilitation and maintenance of water scheme, and essential life-saving WASH NFIs with hygiene practices and access to basic latrine services . lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThelt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtWASH programslt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtresponse lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtactivities are : promoting good hygiene practices, providing safe drinking water providing appropriate sanitation facilities, reducing environmental health risks and ensuring conditions that allow people to live with good health, dignity, comfort and safety.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThe overall objective of the protection is to provide live-saving basic services in reduce the risk and impact of GBV through improving access to life-saving and qualitylt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtGBV services for the targetedlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtfor vulnerable populationlt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtaffected by multiple emergencies . The Protection Responses will includes risk mitigation, and distribution of dignity kits, provision of GBV serviceslt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt, strengthening essential services for survivors of GBV, including case management and psychosocial support services. Whereas The agricultures sector major activities includes provide emergency seed support of improved crop seeds for agro- pastoral households (Host and IDPs), provide livestock veterinary drugs. The integrated multispectral emergency responselt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtwill be implemented in an integrated manner for improved synergetic impact on the life of communities affected by drought with multisectoral Humanitarian need. MCMDO will make sure that people with specific needs or vulnerabilities are prioritized and supported. MCMDO will ensure that protection is mainstreamed throughout all activities and try understanding who is at risks.lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtMCMDO will establish a complaints and feedback response mechanism (CRM) for community feedback on WASH, MPC, agriculture and protection services All targeted households will be provided with information on the project, MCMDO, their entitlements, and modalities for collection of cash, WASH NFI, agricultural inputslt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gt lt/spangtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtas well as ways to make contact with MCMDO and provide feedback through the CRM or by other means.
